requirement:
The Python repository you were given has a bug. Fix it in place so the behaviour described in SPEC holds. Keep every public function and its signature, keep the existing tests passing, and add a regression test that would have caught the bug.

SYMPTOM: `parse_duration('1h30m')` returns 3600 (the minutes are ignored when hours are present).

SPEC: Parse strings made of <int>h, <int>m, <int>s parts in that order (each optional, at least one) into total seconds. Anything else raises ValueError.

The code is in `lib/duration.py`; read it from the repository (it is not repeated here).
acceptance_criteria: Parse strings made of <int>h, <int>m, <int>s parts in that order (each optional, at least one) into total seconds. Anything else raises ValueError.
